sections.Profile:
The Space Jam pinball machine, released by Sega Pinball in 1996, is themed around the popular film featuring Michael Jordan and the Looney Tunes characters. Designed by Joe Kaminkow, Lonnie D. Ropp, and Orin Day, the game includes artwork by Morgan Weistling and music by Brian Schmidt.

- Manufacturer: Sega Pinball Inc. (US)
- Years made: 1996
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
